content: Nenga nakighogholo ninnyandikii mwenga ambujha jhuhaghulilwe pamonga na lilongo lya bhando lilinyeketii Kilichitu linilipahi hake. Chi nenga tugha, nambo bhoha bhibhamanya uchakaka ndi bhibhampala mangota,
nhwalo uchakaka ubhii nkate jhito naujhendelela kubhehe na twenga machiko ghoha ghangapeta.
Umbone na kiya na uteeke ghuhuma kwa Chapanga Tate na kwa Yecho Kilichitu, Mwana gwa Tate, ubhaha pamonga na twenga mu uchakaka na upalo.
Nikahangine hake kulola panakate jha yana hino bhabhii, bhitama mu uchakaka ngita Tate chatulobholile.
Bhahe, ngohe mbujha, ngwete chimo cha kunyope kwino, tupalane. Kujhopa kongo chi lilaghilo lihyono, nambo ndi lilaghilo lelalela litubhinalo kubhoke pitutumbwila.
Kupalana ndi kongo: Kutama kwa kukamuu nhwilo gwa Chapanga. Lilaghilo limujhohina kuhumii makacho ndi lende. Mabhoha mipalwa kutama kwa kupalana.
Bhando bhamahele bhibhahobhecha bhando bhabhii pannema, bhando bheniya bhijheketejhe ngita Yecho Kilichitu ahikiti kwito kwa yegha jha kimundo. Mundo jwalonge naha ndi nhwange na ankana Kilichitu.
Yene mukichunge mabhene nkoto kuhobheha chela chimukihengela lihengo, nambo uhike kupokela hupo jhino telatela.
Mundo jhojhoha jwajhonjekeya chochoha na jwangatamikii mu mabholo gha Kilichitu, jwenio akwetii jhe Chapanga. Nambo jwajhendele kutama mu mabholo gheniya, akwete Tate na Mwana hele.
Kwa gheniya, mundo ahika kwino mangota na changammola mabholo gheniya, nkoto kumpoke kajhino hilu mangannyambucha.
Nhwalo jwanyambucha mundo jwenio, abhii nako pamonga mu kuhenga ghanganandela.
Ngwete ghamahena ghakunnobhole, nambo mbahijhe kulonge kwa kunnyandikila, nambo nihobholela pumbakuhika kwino kulonge pamonga na mangota kupala luhangano lwito lukamilike.
Yana ya nnombo gwino ihaghulilwe na Chapanga innyambucha.
